claims.quote: `bun run history check` counts the rules in force that no probe of Lion checks, beside what the model holds, and `["untested", "?rule"]` lists them
Lion evaluates a program entirely in memory: no file of the core imports a module of the host, such as `node:fs`, or calls `fetch`, `require`, or `process`

says.statement: A Lion program can be evaluated entirely in memory: no file of the core imports a module of the host or calls into it

claims.quote: A string that holds a program written in parentheses is a string, since Lion reads programs only as JSON: `["eval", "(number/add 1 2)"]` is `"(number/add 1 2)"`

says.statement: A Lion program is a JSON value, evaluated as it is, with no parser of its own

claims.quote: No script of a package, the commit hook, or CI runs `npm` or `npx`

says.statement: Never use npx or npm; use bun or turbo

claims.quote: Every exception in the interop grid is listed in `KNOWN`, and the record runs `bun run measure` to see that none is `NOT DOCUMENTED`

says.statement: Every exception in the interop grid is documented and listed in KNOWN
